candidates.claim_summary: AES operates on a 128-bit input/output block.
AES permits 128-, 192-, and 256-bit keys and associates them with 10, 12, and 14 rounds.
ARIA uses 128-, 192-, and 256-bit keys with 12, 14, and 16 rounds respectively.
SEED uses a 128-bit key and a 128-bit data block.
